text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I did it! I seized first place!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Did you see how excited the crowd got
as I cut
through my rivals with my
explosive speed?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
All the leg strength I've built up for
today has
filled me with princess pride!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: 次のレースも頑張ろう

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ I wouldn't have it any other
way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For this princess is strong! Noble! And
resolute!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now on to the next race! With my
supersonic
high-speed running...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess never lets her guard down!
My diligent
efforts must be constant!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll build my leg strength and spirit to
even
greater levels than before!
